title: %xnpv — net present value of dated cash flows
purpose: Discount cash flows that occur on specific dates and sum them, on a 365-day basis.
notes: Each amount is discounted by (1+rate)^((date - firstDate)/365); the first date is the t=0 reference.
amounts and dates must have equal length; otherwise the result is ~.
Output is a TS shortest-round-trip float (last-digit f64 differs cross-language); verified in TS only.
